description: Defines the artwork assets for player-card decoration plates used on profiles, rankings, battle-situation overviews, and customization tiles.

Id.technical: FName key saved in FGamePlayerCardParameter::PlateId and packed into leaderboard cards as a numeric string. Validate() and ResetUnownedIds substitute '1' when the row is missing or its linked Plate item is not owned. Widgets and tile items look up the row by this ID; owned plate lists are built by matching Item::VariableId to the row ID.

ImageFileName.technical: FName resolved through FindDynamicLoadTexture and applied to the main player-card plate image. CollectTextureNames also adds this name to the primary-asset prefetch list for the current card. No thumbnail logic uses this field.

ThumbnailImageFileName.simple: Small plate texture asset name for lists and previews.
ThumbnailImageFileName.technical: FName used by GameItem_GetImageFileName and plate tile async texture loading, and resolved by UGamePlayerCardPlateWidget::SetThumbnailImage for tile previews. It is the row field referenced by the Item-to-Plate asset join through Item::VariableId.

notes: The export contains 463 rows; IDs are numeric strings and both texture fields are unique per row in the export.
Multiple PlayerCardPlateDataTable shards are supported; DTM_FindPlayerCardPlateRow loops them and returns the first match.

Plate row lookups are unguarded in several UI paths, so an invalid saved ID can lead to a null dereference rather than a graceful fallback; Validate is the sanitizer that prevents this for local player and leaderboard cards.
Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available; no claim is made about all Blueprint or editor-tool uses.

usages.detail: Builds owned plate rows from owned Plate items' VariableId values.
Applies the full ImageFileName texture to the profile card.
Applies the ThumbnailImageFileName texture to plate previews.
Requests asynchronous loading of the thumbnail texture for plate tiles.
Uses the Plate row's thumbnail as the Item icon image for Plate-type items.
Resolves a player's plate row for the battle-situation overview.
